cmd: [ -z "$(find . \( -name node_modules -o -name .git -o -name .venv -o -name __pycache__ \) -prune -o -name '*.sh' -print -quit 2>/dev/null)" ] && exit 0; find . \( -name node_modules -o -name .git -o -name .venv -o -name __pycache__ \) -prune -o -name '*.sh' -print0 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 awk '/^[[:space:]]*trap/ && /EXIT/ && !/^[[:space:]]*trap[[:space:]]+(-|--)/ {c[FILENAME]++} END {bad=0; for (fn in c) if (c[fn]>1) {print "double-EXIT-trap: " fn; bad=1} exit bad}'; rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 123 ] && rc=1; exit $rc

grep -rnE '^[[:space:]]*\[.*\][[:space:]]*#.*\|\| *FAIL' --include='*.sh' --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.venv . ; rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 1 ] && exit 0; if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then echo 'guard-swallow: || FAIL 被注释吞（防线假活）'; exit 1; fi; exit $rc

out=$(grep -rnE "docker exec .*(-e|--env)[= ]*['\"]?PGPASSWORD=" --include='*.sh' --include='*.py' --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.venv . | grep -vE 'printf|echo '); rc0=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; [ $rc0 -ge 2 ] && exit $rc0; [ $rc0 -eq 1 ] && exit 0; [ -n "${out}" ] && { echo 'cred-expose: PGPASSWORD 经 docker exec -e 暴露进程列表'; exit 1; }; exit 0
